Package ui

Class PaymentDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.control.Dialog<PaymentResult>
ui.PaymentDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
public final class PaymentDialog extends javafx.scene.control.Dialog<PaymentResult>
Tip and payment method for the current order. Returns null if the cashier cancels.

    • PaymentDialog

      public PaymentDialog(double subtotal)

      Parameters:
      subtotal - the order's total before tax and tip

  • Method Details

    • parseTip

      static double parseTip(String text)
      Reads the custom tip box. Shared with CustomerView.
      Parameters:
      text - what was typed, already limited to TIP_PATTERN by the text formatter
      Returns:
      the tip in dollars, or 0 when the box is empty or can't be read (for example just ".")
